The Pynapple website contains [various examples](https://pynapple.org/examples.html) that start from real data and show you 
how to perform some typical neuroscience analyses.

Pick one and see if you can reproduce it:

- [Null distributions to test spatial firing](https://pynapple.org/examples/tutorial_null_distributions.html)
- [Detecting sharp-wave ripples](https://pynapple.org/examples/tutorial_ripple_detection.html)
- [Analyzing calcium imaging data](https://pynapple.org/examples/tutorial_calcium_imaging.html)

If you have your own data, feel free to come and ask me for help analysing it!
